output.headline: Ironvale's interceptions choke Northgate's patient build-up
output.text: Ironvale Athletic won the ball back 3 times in 120 seconds, with interceptions by Callum Reid, Marco Silvan and Zeke Mbeki. Protecting a 1-0 lead with 44 percent possession, their deep block keeps forcing turnovers from Northgate's patient passing.
